items.title: Ingredients
items.text:
• 1-2 lb chicken wings
  • Sweet Baby Ray’s buffalo sauce
  • pork barrel barbeque dry rub
  • meat thermometer

items.title: Instructions
items.text:
1. Defrost the chicken wings, if needed.
  2. On a separate plate, sprinkle the dry rub on each side of the wing.
  3. In the air fryer, add your wings at 390 degrees Farenheit for 3 mins.
  4. Open the air fryer and flip the wings for another 3 mins.
  5. Rotate the wings and drizzle the buffalo sauce on the wings. Cook for 4 mins.
  6. Rotate the wings, drizzle the buffalo sauce, and cook for 4 mins.
  7. Continue rotating the wings, adding sauce, and cooking for 3 mins on each side until the internal temperature of the wing is 165 degrees Farenheit.

items.title: Ingredients
items.text:
• ½ cup butter
  • 2 ribs celery, diced
  • 1 onion, diced
  • 1 carrot, diced
  • ½ cup flour
  • 1 quart chicken stock
  • 2 cups heavy cream
  • 10 oz shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
  • 8 oz American cheese.
  • 1 Tbsp cornstarch
  • 1 Tbsp Worcestershire
  • 24 oz beer (dry not too sweet)
  • ½ tsp yellow food coloring
  • 2 tsp Tabasco
  • bay leaf
  • 2 sprigs of fresh thyme
  • salt and pepper
  • ½ cup chopped fresh chives
  • freshly popped popcorn

items.title: Instructions
items.text:
1. Place American Cheese in the freezer for about 30 min.
  2. Remove from the freezer and shred.
  3. Mix with Cheddar and 1 Tbsp cornstarch.  Set aside.
  4. In a large heavy pot, melt butter.
  5. Add onion, carrot, and celery.
  6. Add bay leaf and thyme sprigs
  7. Sauté until onions are translucent and vegetables are soft.
  8. Stir in flour. Combine thoroughly.
  9. Cook for 5 min on medium heat.
  10. Stir in 12 oz of Beer, chicken stock, and cream.
  11. Stir constantly for about 10-12 min until smooth and thickened.
  12. Turn heat to low.
  13. Using a wire whisk, whisk in cheese mixture slowly small amounts at a time until all cheese is incorporated and soup is smooth.
  14. Add Worcestershire, food coloring, and Tabasco.
  15. Remove bay leaf and thyme leaf.
  16. Simmer at very low heat for 10 min.
  17. Taste and season with salt and pepper
  18. Stir in the remaining beer.
  19. Serve with chopped chives and popcorn.

items.title: Ingredients
items.text:
• 2 - 10 oz cans chicken (drained)
  • 2 - 8 oz packages softened cream cheese
  • 1 cup ranch or blue cheese dressing
  • ¾ cup hot sauce
  • 1 ½ cups shredded Cheddar cheese

items.title: Instructions
items.text:
1. Heat chicken and hot sauce in a skillet on medium heat.
  2. Stir in cream cheese and dressing until warm and blended.
  3. Mix in ½ shredded cheese and transfer to a slow cooker.
  4. Sprinkle on the remaining cheese and cover.
  5. Cook on low till hot and bubbly.
  6. Serve with celery and crackers.

items.title: Ingredients
items.text:
• 1 lb ground chorizo (or ground hot Italian sausage)
  • 2 Tbsp olive oil
  • 1 small onion, diced
  • 2 jalapeños, seeded and diced
  • 4 garlic cloves, diced
  • 1 (10 oz) can diced tomatoes and green chiles (Rotel works well)
  • 2 (7 oz) cans mild chiles
  • 1 bunch cilantro, chopped
  • 1 (26 oz) Velveeta cheese, cubed
  • 1 (12 oz) can evaporated milk
  • 1 cup half-and-half
  • 2 Tbsp hot sauce
  • 1 Tbsp ground cumin
  • 1 Tbsp chili powder
  • juices of 2 limes
  • 1 to 2 cups of water

items.title: Instructions
items.text:
1. Brown the chorizo in a skillet over medium heat (around 6-8 minutes).
  2. Drain in a colander.
  3. Set aside (chorizo renders a lot of fat and no one wants greasy queso).
  4. In the same skillet, combine olive oil, onion, and jalapeños and sauté for 6 to 7 minutes, until the veggies start to brown.
  5. Add the garlic and sauté for 2 more minutes.
  6. Add the sautéed veggies and browned chorizo into your Crockpot.
  7. Add everything else in the ingredients list into the Crockpot. Add water to your own desired thickness level.
  8. Cover the crockpot and set it on High.
  9. As the cheese starts to melt, stir to combine the ingredients together.
  10. When you have it like you want it, turn heat to low.

items.title: Ingredients
items.text:
• 4 Tbsp olive oil
  • 1 lb cherry tomatoes
  • 4 cloves garlic, minced
  • 1 small shallot (or 1 small or green onion thinly sliced)
  • pinch of red pepper flakes or pinch to an 1/8 tsp paprika
  • sea salt
  • fresh cracked pepper
  • 7oz block of feta cut into 2 slabs
  • handful fresh basil

items.title: Instructions
items.text:
1. Preheat oven to 400 F
  2. Place 1 rack in oven to middle and place another rack to the top close to broiler
  3. Pour 2 Tbsp olive oil into a 8- or 9-inch baking dish (or something similar).
  4. Add the tomatoes, garlic, shallots and paprika.
  5. Sprinkle with pinch of sea salt and pepper to taste. Toss to coat.
  6. Add the Feta and drizzle with remaining Olive Oil. Crack more pepper over top to taste.
  7. Transfer pan to middle rack for 20 minutes,
  8. After the 20 minutes transfer the pan to top rack and switch to your oven's broiler option. Broil on high for 5 minutes, keeping a close eye the entire time.
  9. Once out of the oven smash the feta a sprinkle with fresh basil.
  10. Serve with pita chips, crackers or bread.

items.title: Ingredients
items.text:
• 3 Haas avocados, halved, seeded and peeled
  • 1 lime, juiced
  • 1/2 tsp kosher salt
  • 1/2 tsp ground cumin
  • 1/2 tsp cayenne
  • 1/2 medium onion, diced
  • 1/2 jalapeno pepper, seeded and minced
  • 2 Roma tomatoes, seeded and diced
  • 1 Tbsp chopped cilantro
  • 1 clove garlic, minced

items.title: Instructions
items.text:
1. In a large bowl place the scooped avocado pulp and lime juice, toss to coat.
  2. Drain, and reserve the lime juice, after all of the avocados have been coated.
  3. Using a potato masher add the salt, cumin, and cayenne and mash, then fold in the onions, tomatoes, cilantro, and garlic.
  4. Add 1 Tbsp of the reserved lime juice.
  5. Let sit at room temperature for 1 hour and then serve.

items.title: Ingredients
items.text:
• 4 cups mixed nuts (used cashews)
  • 2 Tbsp chopped fresh rosemary (about 2-3 large sprigs)
  • 2 Tbsp maple syrup
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • 2 Tbsp olive oil
  • 1/2 tsp smoked paprika
  • 1 1/2 tsp salt

items.title: Instructions
items.text:

items.title: For the Starter (Levain)
items.text:
• 1 Tbsp active 100 percent hydration starter
  • 200 grams warm water
  • 100 grams all purpose flour
  • 100 grams whole wheat flour

items.title: For the Final Dough
items.text:
• 200 grams of the starter
  • 700 grams warm water
  • 900 grams of bread flour
  • 100 grams whole wheat flour
  • 20 grams salt
  • 50/50 mixture of whole wheat and rice flour for dusting

items.title: Instructions
items.text:
1. The night before you mix the dough, prepare your levain (starter) by mixing the starter, water, and flours. Cover with plastic wrap, and let sit overnight.
  2. To make the final dough, in a large bowl, add 200 grams of the starter, 650 grams of the warm water, and the flours. Mix by hand until incorporated, cover, and let rest in a warm spot in your kitchen for about 30 to 40 minutes.
  3. Sprinkle the salt over the dough and sprinkle with the rest of the water. Mix by hand, pinching the dough to dissolve the salt, and stretching and folding the dough over itself. Cover and let it rest in a warm spot for 30 minutes.
  4. Let rise for 3 hours, stretching and folding with a wet hand every 30 minutes, until the dough is buoyant and aerated.
  5. Using a dough scraper, gently coax the dough out of the bowl onto an unfloured work surface. Lightly flour the top of the dough, and divide it in half with a bench scraper. With the bench scraper, flip the dough pieces so that the floured side is on the bottom.
  6. Shape the dough pieces into boules by gently folding the dough over itself from all "sides." Flip the shaped dough over so that the seam side is on the counter. Using a bench scraper, draw the loaf toward you, and then away from you, to tighten up the top of the dough. Cover each piece with a towel and let rest for 10 minutes. In the meantime, dust two bannetons or towel lined bowls with a 50-50 mixture of wheat and rice flour.
  7. After the 10 minutes, flip the dough over, and reshape the loaf one more time. Flip the loaf back over, seam side down, and place the bench scraper under the shaped loaf. Push it around from all four sides against the work surface to create tension and tighten up the loaf. Place the shaped dough into the banneton, seam side up. Pinch the seam a few times to make sure it stays closed. Cover with oiled plastic wrap.
  8. You can either let the loaves rise at room temperature for 2 to 4 hours, until puffy, and then bake. Alternatively, you can place the shaped loaves in the refrigerator for up to 12 hours for a more sour flavor.
  9. About 30 minutes before baking, place a Dutch oven in the oven and preheat it to 500 degrees F. Remove your loaf from the refrigerator.
  10. When ready to bake, pull the Dutch oven out of your oven and, using this method, transfer the loaf to the hot pan and score it with your favorite scoring pattern. Carefully return the hot lid to the pan, and place it in the oven, and immediately reduce the oven temperature to 450 degrees F.
  11. Bake for 30 minutes, remove the lid, and bake for 15 to 20 minutes more, until the interior of the loaf reaches about 205 degrees F, and the crust is a deep brown. Cool completely on a wire rack before slicing.
  12. Repeat with the second loaf

items.text:
• 1 cup (230g) unsalted butter, at room temperature
  • 1 cup (200g) packed brown sugar (if keto, substitute with Swerve)
  • 1/4 cup (50g) granulated sugar (if keto, substitute with Swerve)
  • 2 large eggs at room temp
  • 1 Tbsp pure vanilla extract (yes, tablespoon!)
  • 1 Tbsp molasses
  • 1 1/2 cups (188g) all-purpose flour (spoon & leveled)
  • 1 tsp baking soda
  • 1 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 3 cups (240g) old-fashioned rolled oats*
  • 1 cup (140g) Craisins*
  • optional: 1/2 cup (64g) chopped toasted walnuts

items.title: Instructions
items.text:
1. Using a hand mixer or a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, cream the softened butter and both sugars together on medium speed until smooth, about 2 minutes. Add the eggs and mix on high until combined, about 1 minute. Scrape down the sides and bottom of the bowl as needed. Add the vanilla and molasses and mix on high until combined. Set aside.
  2. In a separate bowl, whisk the flour, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt together. Add to the wet ingredients and mix on low until combined. Beat in the oats, raisins, and walnuts (if using) at low speed. The dough will be thick, yet very sticky. Chill the dough for 30-60 minutes in the refrigerator (do the full hour if you’re afraid of the cookies spreading too much). If chilling for longer (up to 2 days), allow to sit at room temperature for at least 30 minutes before rolling and baking.
  3. Preheat oven to 350°F (177°C). Line two large baking sheets with parchment paper or silicone baking mats. Set aside.
  4. Roll balls of dough (about 2 Tbsp of dough per cookie) and place 2 inches apart on the baking sheets. I recommend using a cookie scoopsince the dough can be sticky. Bake for 12-14 (10-11 convection) minutes until lightly browned on the sides. The centers will look very soft and under-baked. Remove from the oven and let cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely. The cookies will continue to “set” on the baking sheet during this time.

items.title: Notes
items.text:
1. Make-Ahead & Freezing Instructions: Cookies stay fresh covered at room temperature for up to 1 week. Baked cookies freeze well – up to three months. Unbaked cookie dough balls freeze well – up to three months. Bake frozen cookie dough balls for an extra minute, no need to thaw. Here’s how to freeze cookie dough.
  2. Oats: For these oatmeal raisin cookies, I use old-fashioned whole oats. They provide the ultimate hearty, chewy, thick texture we love!
  3. Eggs: Room temperature eggs preferred. A good rule of thumb: always use room temperature eggs when using room temperature butter.
  4. Raisins: Soak your raisins in warm water for 10 minutes before using (blot very well to dry them) – this makes them nice and plump for your cookies.
  5. Adapted from Loaded Oatmeal Cookies&Oatmeal Creme Pies. Recipe originally published on Sally’s Baking Addictionin 2014.

items.title: Ingredients
items.text:
• 2¼ cups flour (regular, all purpose flour)
  • 3 Tbsp cornstarch
  • 3 Tbsp natural cocoa powder (unsweetened, best not to use dutch processed (see note 8))
  • ½ tsp baking soda
  • 1 tsp baking powder
  • ½ tsp salt (omit if using salted butter)
  • 6 Tbsp unsalted butter (room temperature)
  • ¾ cup unflavoured vegetable oil (I use canola)
  • 1¾ cups white granulated sugar
  • 3 large eggs (room temperature)
  • 1 Tbsp vanilla essence/extract
  • 1½ tsp white vinegar
  • 3½ Tbsp red liquid food colouring
  • ¾ cup buttermilk (room temperature)
  • 1½ cups white granulated sugar
  • ½ cup flour (regular, all purpose flour)
  • 1½ cups milk (full fat)
  • 1½ cups unsalted butter (room temperature)
  • 1½ tsps vanilla extract/essence
  • ⅛ tsp salt
path: Red Velvet Cake with Ermine Frosting

items.title: Instructions
items.text:
1. Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F) (see note 7 for convection oven) and grease and/or line two 8 inch cake tins.
  2. Sift together the flour, cornstarch, cocoa powder, baking soda, baking powder and salt. Whisk or fork until well combined, then set aside.
  3. In another bowl, cream together the butter, vegetable oil and sugar with an electric mixer for 2-3 minutes, until light and creamy.
  4. Add the eggs one by one, mixing well for about 10-15 seconds between each addition.
  5. Add the vanilla, vinegar and red liquid food colour, and mix until well combined. Set the mixer aside.
  6. Fold half of the dry ingredients into the wet mixture with a spatula until just combined. Fold in all of the buttermilk, then fold in the remaining dry ingredients until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Divide the batter evenly between the two 8 inch cake tins and bake for 30-35 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean. Do not open the oven door too early, and avoid overbaking.
  8. Cool the cakes in their tins for about 15-20 minutes, then turn them out onto a wire rack to cool completely before frosting.
  9. Place a saucepan over medium heat and add the sugar and flour. Whisk or stir continuously for 2 minutes to gently toast the flour without letting it burn or change colour visibly.
  10. Add 3/4s of a cup of milk (180g) and mix until smooth. Add the remaining 3/4s of a cup (180g) of milk and mix until smooth, using 1 and 1/2 cup of milk (360g) in total.
  11. Stir gently until the mixture begins to bubble, then continue stirring for another minute, until thick and paste/pudding-like.
  12. Cool the mixture to room temperature. To prevent a skin from forming, pour it onto a plate, cover it with cling wrap pressed against the surface, and freeze for 30 minutes.
  13. Whip the butter in a large bowl with a hand or stand mixer on medium-high speed for 5 minutes, until light and fluffy.
  14. Add the flour and milk mixture a tablespoon at a time while continuously mixing. Make sure the mixture is at room temperature, not hot or cold, to prevent curdling.
  15. Add the vanilla and salt, and mix until well combined. Use the frosting once ready.

items.text:

  • 4 tsp instant or rapid-rise yeast
  • 2 Tbsp granulated sugar
  • 2 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
  • 2 1/2 tsp baking powder
  • 3/4 tsp salt
  • 6 Tbsp unsalted butter, melted

items.title: Glaze
items.text:
• 3 oz cream cheese, softened
  • 2 Tbsp whole milk
  • 1/2 tsp vanilla extract
  • 1/8 tsp salt
  • 1 c powdered sugar, sifted

items.title: Instructions
items.text:
1. For the filling:
    1. Combine brown sugar, granulated sugar, cinnamon, and salt in a bow.
    2. Stir in melted butter and vanilla until mixture resembles wet sand, set aside.

  2. For the Dough:

    1. Grease dark 9-inch round cake pan, line with parchment paper, and grease parchment.
    2. Pour 1/4 cup milk in a small bowl and microwave until 110 degrees, 15 to 20 seconds.
    3. Stir in yeast and 2 tsp sugar and let sit until mixture is bubbly (about 5 minutes).
    4. Whisk flour, baking powder, salt, and the remaining 5 tsp of sugar together in a large bowl.
    5. Stir in 2 Tbsp butter, yeast mixture, and remaining 1 c milk until dough forms (dough will be sticky).
    6. Transfer dough to a well-floured counter and knead until smooth ball forms, about 2 minutes.
    7. Roll dough into a 12 by inch rectangle, with a long side parallel to the counter edge.
    8. Brush dough all over with 2 Tbsp butter, leaving 1/2 inch border on the far edge.
    9. Sprinkle dough evenly with filling, then press filling firmly into dough.
    10. Using a bench scraper or metal spatula, loosen the dough from the counter.
    11. Roll dough away from you into a tight log and pinch seam to seal.

    12. Roll log seam side down and cut into 8 equal pieces. Stand buns on end and gently re-form ends that were pinched during cutting.

    13. Place 1 bun in the center of the prepared pan and others around the perimeter of the pan, seams sides facing in.

    14. Brush tops of buns with remaining 2 Tbsp butter.
    15. Cover buns loosely with plastic wrap and let rise for 30 minutes.
    16. Adjust oven rack to middle position and heave oven to 350 degrees.
    17. Discard plastic and bake buns until edges are well browned, 23 to 25 minutes. Loosen buns from the sides of the pan with a paring knife and let cool for 5 minutes.
    18. Invert a large plate over the cake pan. Using potholders, flip plate, and pan upside down; remove pan and parchment.
    19. Reinvert buns onto a wire rack, set a wire rack inside a parchment-lined rimmed baking sheet, and let cool for 5 minutes.
    20. For the Glaze:
    21. Place the cream cheese in a large bowl and whisk in butter, milk, vanilla, and salt until smooth.
    22. Whisk in sugar until smooth.
    23. Pour glaze evenly over the tops of buns, spreading with a spatula to cover.
    24. Serve.

items.title: Instructions
items.text:
1. Preheat the oven to 400˚ F.
  2. Lightly grease a cookie sheet.
  3. If using larger fruit, cut into bite-sized pieces (be sure to make small pieces).
  4. Sprinkle fruit with ½ Tbsp sugar and set aside.
  5. Combine remaining sugar with flour, baking powder, and salt.

  7. Stir in fruit.

  9. Use a spatula to gently stir the dough until it holds together.
  10. Turn onto a lightly floured surface and knead a few times to incorporate dry ingredients (be gentle so as not to damage the fruit).
  11. Sprinkle dough with flour if it is sticky.

  • kosher salt
  • 6 Tbsp (85g) unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 1/2 cups (360ml) homemade or store-bought low-sodium chicken stock
  • 2 packets unflavored gelatin (about 5 tsp; 1/2 oz; 14g)
  • 2 Tbsp (30ml) vegetable oil
  • 2 1/2 lb (1kg) ground beef or lamb, or some combination (see note)
  • 1 large yellow onion (about 14 oz; 400g), diced
  • 3 medium carrots (about 8 oz; 225g), diced
  • 2 ribs celery (about 4 oz; 110g), diced
  • 2 medium cloves garlic, minced
  • 2 Tbsp (30ml) tomato paste
  • 1 cup (240ml) dry red wine
  • 2 sprigs thyme
  • 1 bay leaf

  • 1 tsp (5ml) marmite (optional)
  • 2 Tbsp (15g) all-purpose flour

  • 1 1/2 cups (360ml) heavy cream
  • grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, for topping (optional)

items.title: Instructions
items.text:
1. Set cubed potatoes in a colander and rinse under cold water until the water runs clear. Transfer to a large saucepan, cover with cold water by at least 2 inches, and season the water with salt until almost as salty as the sea.
  2. Bring the potatoes to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer until a knife easily pierces them with no resistance, 10 to 15 minutes.
  3. Drain the potatoes in a colander, rinse with hot running water for 30 seconds, and transfer them to a large bowl.
  4. Using a potato masher, food mill, or ricer, mash the potatoes with butter. Press the surface smooth, cover it directly with plastic wrap to prevent a skin from forming, and set aside until ready to assemble.
  5. Place the stock in a 2-cup liquid measuring cup, sprinkle with gelatin, and set aside.
  6. Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over high heat until shimmering. Add half of the ground meat and cook, stirring and scraping the bottom of the pot, until well browned, 6 to 8 minutes. Use a potato masher or large whisk to break up the meat.
  7. Add the remaining meat and cook, breaking it up with the masher or whisk, until reduced to small bits, about 3 minutes. Lower the heat as necessary to prevent scorching.
  8. If the meat has rendered an excessive amount of fat, ladle most of it out with a metal spoon, leaving just a few tablespoons in the pot.
  9. Add the onion, carrots, celery, and garlic. Cook, stirring and scraping the bottom of the pot, until just beginning to soften slightly, about 4 minutes.
  10. Add the tomato paste and cook over medium heat, stirring, for 1 minute.
  11. Add the red wine and bring to a simmer over high heat. Cook, scraping up any browned bits, until almost fully evaporated.
  12. Add the reserved chicken stock, thyme, bay leaf, Worcestershire, and Marmite, if using.
  13. Sprinkle the flour over the ground meat in the pot, then stir it in. Bring to a simmer, reduce the heat to low, and simmer until the sauce is reduced and thick, about 20 minutes.
  14. Discard the thyme sprigs and bay leaf. Stir in the peas and season with salt and pepper.
  15. Adjust the oven rack to the center position and preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
  16. Before assembling, heat the cream in a large saucepan until simmering. Add the potatoes and stir gently until completely incorporated. Season with salt and pepper.
  17. Set a 9- by 13-inch baking dish on a foil-lined rimmed baking sheet. Add the meat sauce, being careful not to fill the dish more than halfway. You might not need all of the sauce, depending on the exact size of your baking dish.
  18. Top with the mashed potatoes, spreading them with a spatula to cover the surface completely. Use the spatula to create a dappled pattern on top of the potatoes.
  19. Sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese, if using.
  20. Transfer the casserole to the oven and bake until the top is browned and the casserole is fully heated through, about 20 minutes.
  21. For deeper browning, place the casserole on a rack set about 6 inches under a hot broiler for the last few moments of cooking. Monitor closely to prevent the potatoes from burning.
  22. Let stand 15 to 20 minutes before serving.

  10. Serve with in a bowl with optional tortillas, tortilla chips, cilantro, jalapenos, tomatoes, guacamole. For Keto, serve over pork rinds.

items.text:

items.title: Pizza Sauce
items.text:

  • 5 cloves garlic, minced
  • 1 can crushed tomatoes
  • 1 tsp dried basil
  • 3/4 tsp dried oregano
  • 1/4 tsp dried thyme
  • 1/4 tsp freshly ground pepper
  • 1 1/2 - 2 Tbsp red wind vinegar
  • kosher salt

items.title: Pizza Toppings
items.text:

  • shredded mozzarella
  • pepperoni

items.title: Pizza dough
items.text:
1. In a food processor, combine flours, yeast, sugar, and salt.
  2. Pulse to mix the ingredients
  3. With the motor running, add the water and olive oil in a steady stream and then pulse until the dough comes together in a rough mass, about 12 seconds.
  4. If the doug does not form into a ball, sprinkle 1-2 tsp of water and pulse again unitl a rough mass forms.
  5. Let the dough rest for 5-10 mins.
  6. Process the dough again for 25-30 seconds, steadying the top of the food processor with one hand. The should be tacky to the touch but not sticky.
  7. Transfer the dough to a lightly floured work surface and form into a smooth ball.
  8. Place the dough in a large oiled bowl, turn to coat with oil, and cover with plastic wrap. Let the dough rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk an dspongy , about 1 1/2 hours.
  9. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured work surface, punch it down, and shape into a smooth cylinder.
  10. Divide into 2 equal pieces. Shape eache piece into a smooth ball, dusting with flour only if the dough becomes sticky.
  11. Cover both balls of dough with a clean kitchen towel and let rest for 10 minutes before proceeding with the rest of the recipe.

items.title: Pizza Sauce
items.text:
1. In a small frying pan, over medium heat, warm the olive oil.
  2. Add the garlic and cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, 1-2 mins. Do not let it scorch or garlic will taste bitter.
  3. In a bowl, stir together the garlic-oil mixture, tomatoes, dried basil, oregano, thyme, pepper, 1/3 cup water, and 1 1/2 Tbsp of vinegar.
  4. Season to taste with salt and additional vinegar.

items.title: Pizza

items.title: Ingredients
items.text:
• 3-3 ½ lb boneless beef chuck roast (or 2-3 lb each beef chuck and pork butt roast)
  • 3 Tbsp oil
  • salt and pepper
  • 4 cloves garlic, peeled and smashed
  • 1 onion, diced
  • 1 carrot, diced
  • 1 stalk celery, diced
  • 1 ½ cups dry red wine
  • 3-4 cups beef stock
  • 2 sprig fresh thyme and parsley
  • 1 tsp black peppercorn
  • 1 ½ lb peeled russet potatoes
  • 1 lb peeled carrots, cut into 2’’ sticks
  • 1 large yellow onion cut into chunks
  • 1 lb turnip, parsnip, or rutabaga
  • equal parts milk and flour whisked together

items.title: Instructions
items.text:
1. Preheat the oven to 325˚ F.
  2. Pat meat dry with a paper towel.
  3. Liberally season both sides with salt and pepper.
  4. In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 Tbsp oil until almost smoking hot.  Brown meat on both sides.
  5. Remove meat from the pan.
  6. Add 1 Tbsp oil, cook onion carrot, and celery for 3-4 minutes.
  7. Add thyme, parsley, and peppercorns
  8. Deglaze pan with red wine, scraping the bottom of the pan.
  9. Place meat on top of vegetables.
  10. Pour enough beef stock into the pot to come up halfway on the roast.  Bring liquid to a boil.
  11. Cover tightly and place in the oven for 3-3 ½ hours. Check a few times—add liquid if needed.
  12. Take out of the oven add potatoes, carrots, onion, and other vegetables.
  13. Cover and replace in the oven for 20-30 min until vegetables are done.
  14. Remove vegetables and keep warm.  Remove roast and cover.
  15. Remove thyme and parsley. Let liquid sit and cool for a few minutes. Skim any excess fat off.
  16. Bring liquid to boil, add milk mixture to make gravy, using a whisk.
  17. Season with salt and pepper.
  18. Slice meat and serve.

items.title: Steps

items.title: For the spice rub and pork
items.text:
1. Combine paprika, pepper, sugar, and salt in a small bowl.
  2. Rub the entire pork roast with the spice mixture. (Roast may be wrapped in plastic wrap and refrigerated for up to 1 day.)
  3. Using a large piece of heavy-duty aluminum foil, wrap soaked chips in a foil packet and cut several vent holes on top.
  4. Open bottom vents of charcoal grill completely. Light large chimney starter filled halfway with charcoal briquettes (3 quarts). When top coals are partially covered with ash, pour evenly over half of the grill. Place wood chip packet on coals. Set cooking grate in place, cover, and open lid vents halfway. Heat grill until hot, about 5 minutes.
  5. Clean and oil cooking grate. Place pork on the cooler side of the grill. Cover, positioning lid vent directly over meat. Cook until the meat has dark, rosy crust and charcoal is spent, about 2 hours.
  6. Meanwhile, adjust the oven rack to the lower-middle position and heat the oven to 325 degrees. Transfer pork to large roasting pan, wrap pan and pork tightly with foil, and roast in the oven until fork slips easily in and out of meat, 2 to 3 hours. Remove from oven and let rest, still wrapped in foil, for 30 minutes.

items.text:

  • 2 yellow onion, peeled and quartered
  • 3-5 jalapeno

  • 2 bunches fresh cilantro.
  • juice of 3 limes
  • oil for frying
  • salt and pepper to taste

items.title: Instructions
items.text:
1. Combine tomatillos, onion, jalapeno, and chicken stock in a large pot.
  2. Bring to boil, simmer for 30-45 minutes until stock is reduced and tomatillos are very soft.
  3. Take off heat and set aside to cool.
  4. When cool, in batches, in a blender add lukewarm mixture (not hot!! It will blow up on you) lime juice and cilantro.
  5. Blend until very smooth. Continue until everything is blended together.  Mix thoroughly.
  6. THE NEXT STEP IS VERY IMPORTANT.. IT WILL MAKE A MESS, AND IS HOT.  DO IT IN SMALL BATCHES.
  7. In a medium skillet.  Add 2 T of vegetable oil and heat to almost smoking hot.  In small amounts add the tomatillo mixture and FRY the liquid stirring using a flat wooden spoon or rubber scraper.
  8. Fry for 3-5 minutes until mixture becomes thicker and changes color slightly and the oil is totally incorporated.  Do not burn it.
  9. Continue with the rest of the mixture cleaning pan if needed and using more oil for each batch.
  10. Serve with Tacos, chips, enchiladas, tamales.

  • 1 tsp dried mint leaf

items.title: Instructions
items.text:

  4. Drain peppers and place in food processor with spices, garlic, salt, lemon and olive oil.
  5. Puree, stopping occasionally to scrape down sides, until a fine smooth paste is formed. About 2 min.
  6. Place paste in sterilized glass jar.
  7. fill jar with enough extra-virgin olive oil to submerge paste.
  8. Refrigerate.  Mix well before use.  Cover remaining with oil and refrigerate

  • 1 cup heavy whipping cream

  • ½ tsp ground black pepper
  • 2 large eggs
  • 1 ½ cups crumbled fresh mozzarella cheese (can also use shredded)

items.title: Instructions
items.text:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F.
  2. Prepare the zucchini:
    1. Remove the top and bottom, and slice it thin.
    2. Place the zucchini slices in a large tray covered with a clean tea towel or paper towel.
    3. Sprinkle some salt on top so they’ll release excess water.
    4. Leave it for 10-15 minutes, and then repeat it on the other side.
    5. Dry the zucchini using a clean towel.
    6. Take a 9’’ round baking pan, and arrange ⅓ -¼ of the zucchini slices on the base. Set aside.
  3. Add two tablespoons of olive oil into a skillet and sauté onion and garlic until fragrant (about 2 minutes). Add sliced green onion (the white part only) and stir until the onion is translucent.
  4. To the skillet, over medium heat, add heavy cream, Cheddar, and Parmesan cheese; mix until smooth and slightly thickened. Remove from heat.
  5. Season cheese mixture with ground black pepper, and add beaten eggs. Whisk to combine.
  6. Cover the zucchini slices with creamy sauce and mozzarella cheese. Repeat two to three more layers with the rest of the zucchini, the sauce, and mozzarella cheese.
  7. Bake this zucchini casserole for 20 minutes or until zucchini is fork-tender. Serve warm.

items.title: Ingredients
items.text:
• 6 egg yolks
  • 2 whole eggs
  • 2 Tbsp cold water
  • 1 tsp salt
  • 2 Tbsp cream or vegetable oil
  • 4 cups sifted flour
  • ½ tsp baking powder

items.title: Instructions
items.text:
1. Excluding the flour and baking powder, beat all the ingredients together
  2. When mixed well, add flour and baking powder to make a stiff dough.
  3. Divide into 5-6 balls.
  4. Roll each into desired thickness.
  5. Fold the dough and slice it into any width you prefer.
  6. Leave on a floured board overnight to dry.
  7. After covering with a clean dish towel, pack into glass jars or plastic bags and store in a deep freezer.

items.title: Ingredients
items.text:
• 1 1/2 lb Italian sausage (1 lb regular and 1/2 lb hot)
  • 1 whole onion, chopped
  • 4 cups beef broth
  • 1 /12 cups water
  • 12 oz can tomato sauce
  • 3 cups carrots, sliced
  • 2 1/2 cups yellow squash, diced
  • 2 bell peppers, diced
  • 1 tsp dried oregano
  • 1 tsp dried basil
  • 8 oz cheese ravioli, cut into halves

items.title: Instructions
items.text:
1. Brown sausage and drain.
  2. In a pot, add the drain sausage, onion, beef broth, tomato sauce, carrots, squash, bell peppers, oregano, and basil.
  3. Cook for the 30 mins
  4. Add the ravioli and cook for 30 mins.
  5. Serve with Parmesan on top of soup.

items.text:

  • 1 lb chicken breasts or rottiserie chicken, cooked

items.text:
1. In a large pot, cook the chicken.
  2. While cooking, prepare your jalapeno.
  3. Add your chicken broth to the pot.
  4. Add ingredients.
  5. Serve with avocado slices, mexican cheese, sour cream, and fritos.

items.title: Ingredients
items.text:
• 28 oz frozen turnip greens'
  • 8oz bacon
  • 6 spring onions
  • 1 Tbsp salt (preferably free range)
  • 1/2 Tbsp pepper
  • 1/2 Tbsp garlic powder
  • 1 tsp cayenne

items.title: Instructions
items.text:
1. Cook kosher certified pork bacon over medium high heat or in oven at 400 degrees until bacon is crispy (15-20 mins).
  2. Add bacon to pot along with greens and spices, covering with gluten free water.
  3. Boil this for 3 mins and then let simmer for 10 mins or until desired texture is achieved.

items.title: Ingredients
items.text:
• 1/2 lb chopped bacon
  • 2 lb beef, cubed
  • 6 large cloves crushed garlic
  • 1/2 lb sausage
  • 6 stalks of celery
  • half head of cauliflower
  • 1 large onion
  • 6-7 carrots
  • 2 15 oz cans diced tomatoes
  • 1 28 oz can crushed tomatoes
  • 1 box organic chicken broth
  • 1 Tbsp chicken bouillon
  • 1 cup barley and/or wild rice

items.title: Instructions
items.text:
1. Brown together the bacon, beef, garlic, and sausage.
  2. While browning, chop and set aside the following:
    1. Celery
    2. Cauliflower
    3. Onion
    4. Carrots
  3. Add diced tomatoes, crushed tomatoes, chicken broth, and chicken bouillon to browned meat.
  4. Add veggies after a 5-10 mins.
  5. Bring to boil
  6. Add Barley and/or wild rice
  7. Bring to boil again then simmer for 20 minutes

items.title: Ingredients
items.text:
• 1 lb Italian sausage
  • 1 leek diced (white only) or 1 small onion
  • 4-5 red potatoes diced in larger pieces
  • 1 box and 1 large can of chicken broth
  • 5-6 large kale leaves
  • ¼ to ½ cup butter
  • 2 Tbsp flour
  • 2 packages dry original ranch dressing
  • 1 ¾ cups half and half

items.title: Instructions
items.text:
1. Brown sausage with the leek or onion.
  2. Boil potatoes in the chicken broth.
  3. Add kale after potatoes are done.
  4. In a saucepan make a white sauce with butter, flour, and ranch dressing.
  5. Add half and half.
  6. Bring to boil and continue boiling for two minutes.
  7. Add to sausage and broth mixture, stirring for 1-2 minutes.
  8. Simmer for 15-20 minutes and turn on low.
  9. Soup can be served immediately or refrigerate after it cools.

items.title: Ingredients
items.text:
• 2 lb hamburger
  • 1 can of pinto beans
  • 1 can kidney beans
  • 1 can of black beans
  • 2 cans diced tomatoes
  • 2 cans Ro-Tel tomatoes
  • 1 package ranch dressing (dry)
  • 1 package taco seasoning
  • 1 can white corn
  • 1 can green chilies
  • onion

items.title: Instructions
items.text:
1. Brown hamburger in a large pot
  2. Add all ingredients and stir
  3. Simmer on low heat until done.
  4. Garnish when serving with sour cream, green onions, grated cheese, and corn chips

items.title: Ingredients
items.text:
• 1 lb Brussels sprouts
  • 1/2 lb bacon
  • 6 Tbsp gochujang
  • 2 Tbsp Bachan’s Japanese barbecue sauce

items.title: Instructions
items.text:
1. Preheat oven to 400 F.
  2. Partially, cook the bacon - get it about 60% done as it will be going in the oven
  3. While the bacon is cooking, wash and halve the Brussels sprouts
  4. In a bowl, mix the 3 Tbsp Gochujang and 1 Tbsp Barbecue sauce together - adjust to your liking.
  5. Add half the Brussels sprouts to the bowl and mix with the sauce.
  6. On a large baking pan, place the Brussels sprouts mixture.
  7. Repeat steps 3-5 with the remaining Brussels sprouts.
  8. When the bacon is finished, place it on a cutting board and chop it into bits. Keep some of the grease.
  9. Spread bacon (and grease) on top of the baking pan
  10. Bake for 40 mins.

items.title: Ingredients
items.text:
• 2 small packages frozen strawberries or raspberries (ensure they are frozen hard)
  • 2 small packages strawberry jello
  • 1 1/2 cups hot water
  • 2 bananas, mashed
  • 1 small can crushed pineapple, well-drained
  • 1 cup sour cream
  • 2-3 Tbsp lemon juice
  • Knox gelatin (just a little)

items.title: Instructions
items.text:
1. Mix jello and hot water
  2. Chop frozen berries into large chunks and add to jello.
  3. Stir until all the ice is melted.
  4. Add lemon juice and Knox Gelatin
  5. Add banana and pineapple
  6. Pour half of this mixture into a pan or mold.
  7. Daub the sour cream over this.
  8. Pour the remainder of the jello mixture on top of the sour cream.
  9. This begins to set almost before you are through with the mixing

items.text:
• 1 rotisserie chicken
  • 3 cups water
  • 2 jars of salsa (whatever kind you like)
  • 1 bag of frozen corn
  • 1 can cannelloni beans
  • 1 can low-fat chicken broth
  • salt and pepper to taste

items.title: Instructions
items.text:
1. Pull all the meet off of the rotisserie chicken.
  2. In a crock pot, combine all the ingredients.
  3. Heat on high for 1 hour or for 10 contiguous minutes of boiling.
  4. Place temperature on low.
  5. Serve with cheese, tortilla chips or Fritos, sour cream, avocado, or anything else you like.

items.title: Ingredients
items.text:
• ¾ cup canola oil
  • ¼ cup lemon juice
  • 2 garlic cloves, minced
  • ½ tsp salt
  • ½ tsp pepper
  • 2 lb romaine lettuce, torn
  • 2 cups chopped tomatoes
  • 1 cup shredded Swiss cheese
  • ⅔ cup slivered toasted almonds
  • ½ cup grated Parmesan cheese
  • 8 slices bacon, crumbled
  • 1 cup Caesar salad croutons

items.title: Instructions
items.text:
1. In a jar with a tight lid, combine oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and pepper.
  2. Cover and shake well.
  3. Chill.
  4. In a serving bowl, toss lettuce, tomatoes, Swiss cheese, almonds, Parmesan cheese, and bacon.
  5. Shake dressing and pour over salad.
  6. Mix the salad.
  7. Add croutons and serve immediately.

items.title: Ingredients
items.text:
• large onion, chopped
  • 6 cloves garlic, crushed
  • 1 1/2 cups celery, chopped
  • 1-2 lb cubed beef (small)
  • olive oil
  • 1 quart chicken stock
  • 6-7 cubed potatoes
  • 2 large cans diced tomatoes
  • 1 1/2 cups carrots
  • (other vegetables to taste)
  • 1 cup barley
  • bay leaf
  • salt & pepper
  • rosemary (opt)

items.title: Instructions
items.text:
1. Sauté with olive oil the chopped onion, garlic, celery, and cubed beef.
  2. Add chicken stock, cubed potatoes, diced tomatoes, and carrots.
  3. Bring to a light boil then add barley.
  4. Reduce heat after 10-15 mins.
  5. Season with bay leaf, salt and pepper, and rosemary.
  6. Cook on low for 40 mins.

items.title: Ingredients
items.text:
• 3 cups cooked wild rice
  • ½ cup craisin
  • 1 small can sliced water chestnuts
  • ½ lb fresh mushroom, sliced
  • 2 ribs celery, diced
  • 1 bunch green onion, diced.
  • 1 red pepper, diced fine.
  • 2 Tbsp fresh parsley, chopped.
  • ¼ cup grated carrot
  • ½ cup or more Marzetti’s raspberry dressing.
  • 2 Tbsp red wine vinegar

items.title: Instructions
items.text:
1. Combine all salad ingredients.  Mix well
  2. Add dressing until just coated.
  3. Stir in vinegar.
  4. Cover and chill for 1 hour.
  5. Stir before serving.  Add more dressing if needed.

items.title: Ingredients
items.text:
• 1/2 cup wild rice
  • 1 lb bacon
  • 3 Tbsp bacon drippings
  • 3/4 cup celery, chopped
  • 1 cup onion, chopped
  • 1/3 cup chopped green pepper
  • 2, 14.5 oz cans (ready to serve) chicken broth
  • 4 oz can mushrooms
  • 3, 10.75 oz cans cream of mushroom soup, undiluted

items.title: Instructions
items.text:
1. Wash wild rice.
  2. Boil rice for 15 minutes and drain. Set aside.
  3. Fry bacon until crisp.
  4. Remove bacon and discard all but 3 Tbsp bacon drippings. Sauté celery, onion, and green pepper in the drippings.
  5. Cook until the onion is transparent.
  6. Put in a large kettle and rice, broth, mushrooms, soup, and dice bacon.
  7. Cook on low heat for 1 hour or more.
